result.title: OpenAI JUST solved math....
result.description:
OpenAI says 10,000 AI agents produced a proposed solution to the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem in just 88 hours. But the announcement has sparked a dispute over credit, competing research, and the role of human mathematicians. We break down the math, Tristan Buckmaster and Levent Alpöge’s work, OpenAI’s response, and what this could mean for the future of scientific discovery.

From Euler’s equations and fluid dynamics to Lean proof verification, this is the story behind the headlines—and the questions that still need answers.

result.title: this JUST became the #1 AI model...
result.description:
I've been building with Claude Fable 5.1 since launch day, and this is what came out: Blood Grid, a fully voiced Blood Bowl-style fantasy football game with its own AI engine, a headless simulator, and a Bradley-Terry balance bench; a Matrix-style bullet-time subway shooter; an isometric Tarkov-style extraction game that plays itself; and The Gilded Mansion, an Among Us-style social deduction game where the players are LLMs. No bugs, no derping out, and it kept warning me about the knock-on effects of my own rule changes before I could break the game. The twist: almost all of it was built on LOW and MEDIUM effort. If you think Fable 5.1 is overrated, your effort slider might just be set too high.
